items.title: Flip the writer default to ON; keep the explicit-OFF escape hatch
items.context: In core/usage-ledger/writer.ts isUsageLedgerEnabled(): when LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER (fallback KOALA_USAGE_LEDGER) is UNSET/undefined, return true (default ON). Keep the existing truthy/falsey parsing so 0/false/off/no/'' explicitly DISABLE. Default ON; explicit OFF respected. Unit-tested: unset -> true; '0'/'false'/'off'/'no' -> false; '1'/'true'/'on'/'yes' -> true.

happy.desc: isUsageLedgerEnabled({}) === true (unset env returns ON by default); WHY: the core behavioral flip, must return true when LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER is absent
isUsageLedgerEnabled({LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER:"1"}) === true; WHY: explicit ON still works after flip
isUsageLedgerEnabled({LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER:"true"}) === true; WHY: truthy string parsed as enabled
isUsageLedgerEnabled({LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER:"on"}) === true; WHY: truthy on parsed as enabled
isUsageLedgerEnabled({LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER:"yes"}) === true; WHY: truthy yes parsed as enabled
isUsageLedgerEnabled({LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER:"0"}) === false; WHY: escape hatch explicit 0 disables
isUsageLedgerEnabled({KOALA_USAGE_LEDGER:"1"}) === true; WHY: legacy KOALA_ alias honored as fallback
isUsageLedgerEnabled({KOALA_USAGE_LEDGER:"0"}) === false; WHY: KOALA_ alias escape hatch works
writer.ts comment updated from Default OFF to Default ON with escape-hatch note; WHY: doc accuracy

edge.desc: isUsageLedgerEnabled({LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER:""}) === false; WHY: empty string is falsy edge case, maps to disabled not the unset default-ON path
isUsageLedgerEnabled({LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER:" 1 "}) === true; WHY: whitespace-padded truthy value is trimmed
isUsageLedgerEnabled({LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER:" FALSE "}) === false; WHY: case-insensitive + trimmed falsy
LATTICE_ takes precedence over KOALA_ when both set: {LATTICE:0,KOALA:1} => false; WHY: LATTICE_ wins ?? chain

adversarial.desc: isUsageLedgerEnabled({LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER:"2"}) === false; WHY: only 1/true/on/yes are truthy, random numeric must not enable
isUsageLedgerEnabled({LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER:"enabled"}) === false; WHY: word that sounds truthy but not in allowed set must not enable
Re-read on every call (not memoized): env=0 => false, delete env => true, env=1 => true in sequence; WHY: process-lifetime toggle without restart

items.title: Escape-hatch regression proof: =0 restores legacy behavior
items.context: Prove that LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER=0 restores the exact pre-rollout default-off behavior: isUsageLedgerEnabled()=false; appendUsageRecord is a strict no-op (no file/dir created); the Claude seam (runClaudeCodeRealLeafDispatch) uses the original spawn args ['--print', promptFile] (buildClaudeSpawnArgs(file,false)) and raw stdout; the budget guard is inert (no block); recordDispatchPreflight/Final no-op. Byte-identical to the historical default-off. Tested explicitly with the env var set to 0.

happy.desc: LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER=0 => isUsageLedgerEnabled({LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER:"0"}) === false; WHY: escape hatch returns disabled, same as pre-rollout default
LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER=0 => appendUsageRecord is strict no-op: call 10 times, no file created, no .lattice dir created; WHY: writer creates zero side effects when disabled
LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER=0 => buildClaudeSpawnArgs(promptFile,false) === ["--print",promptFile]; WHY: spawn args are byte-identical to pre-rollout (no --output-format json)
LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER=0 => recordDispatchPreflight returns null, writes nothing; WHY: preflight is strict no-op when disabled
LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER=0 => recordDispatchFinal returns immediately, writes nothing; WHY: final is strict no-op when disabled

LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER=0 => resolveHardBudget with env lacking LATTICE_HARD_BUDGET_TOKENS returns null; shouldBlockDispatch(false,...) returns {block:false,budget:null}; WHY: budget guard is inert when ledger disabled
LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER=0 + LATTICE_HARD_BUDGET_TOKENS=1000 => shouldBlockDispatch(false,...,999) still {block:false}; WHY: even with a budget configured, disabled ledger means no block

edge.desc: LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER=0 => recordBudgetBlock returns notBlocked even when LATTICE_HARD_BUDGET_TOKENS is set and estimate exceeds it; WHY: the full orchestrator path short-circuits on disabled

LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER=0 => no .lattice/usage/ directory after appendUsageRecord + recordDispatchPreflight + recordDispatchFinal + recordBudgetBlock in sequence; WHY: the entire pipeline leaves zero filesystem trace
KOALA_USAGE_LEDGER=0 (legacy alias) produces same byte-identical no-op as LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER=0; WHY: legacy alias escape hatch parity

adversarial.desc: After flipping default ON, run the FULL escape-hatch sequence with env=0: isUsageLedgerEnabled=false, append 10x no-op, preflight null, final no-op, budget inert, buildClaudeSpawnArgs=[--print,file] — confirm every observable is byte-identical to pre-rollout behavior; WHY: end-to-end regression proof that the escape hatch restores EXACT legacy behavior

With env=0, attempt appendUsageRecord with a valid record containing actual data — confirm {written:false} and zero bytes on disk; WHY: even with a perfect record the writer must not sneak a write through when disabled

With env=0, confirm parseClaudeCliOutput is still callable (pure function, no gate) but the seam never reaches it because buildClaudeSpawnArgs omits --output-format json; WHY: the disabled path never produces JSON output to parse

items.title: Default-on behavior + safety holds
items.context: With the env var UNSET: isUsageLedgerEnabled()=true; appendUsageRecord writes; the Claude seam uses --output-format json with the B-0f7c raw-text fallback on parse failure; ledger errors are caught and never break dispatch; budget is NOT auto-enabled (no LATTICE_HARD_BUDGET_TOKENS => no block). Tested: unset env => writer writes + the seam's enabled path is taken + a parse failure still yields raw text + a ledger error does not propagate.

items.title: Smoke wired + no regression + doc/default note
items.context: Add packages/main/src/tasks/usage-ledger-default-on-smoke.ts (or extend an existing smoke; follow the *-smoke.ts pattern; ✓/✗, non-zero exit; temp dir; restore env hermetically) wired as an npm script, covering CHK-001/002/003. Update any doc/comment that states the flag default (e.g. a comment in writer.ts or a ledger doc) to reflect default-on + the =0 escape hatch. Build green; full ledger suite (usage-ledger/-adapter/-estimate/-diagnostics/-dispatch/-budget/-authority) passes with the NEW default; node bin/lattice.js validate. Assert usage-ledger still imports zero other modules.
